name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Famous Papa Rellena (Mashed Potato Beef Ball)
whyItWorks: Porto's signature savory creation! Fluffy mashed potatoes stuffed with seasoned lean ground beef, lightly coated in panko breadcrumbs and fried golden. The mashed potato interior is soft and soothing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order 2-3 warm Potato Balls fresh from the bakery case; eat slowly.
watchOuts: Light panko coating is fried; interior is pure soft mashed potato and beef
